# Try moving RIGHT to get back to spawn zone
print("Moving RIGHT to spawn zone...")
for i in range(5):
    result = action(['RIGHT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    agent = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b']
    green = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
    print(f"  RIGHT {i+1}: agent cols ~{agent[0]['boundary'][0][1]}, green={len(green)}")
    if green:
        print(f"  Green blocks spawned!")
        break

# If no green blocks, try clicking pink block
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
green = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
if not green:
    print("\nNo green blocks. Trying to click pink block...")
    pink = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'P']
    if pink:
        rows = [p[0] for p in pink[0]['boundary']]
        cols = [p[1] for p in pink[0]['boundary']]
        center_r = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
        center_c = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
        print(f"  Clicking pink at ({center_r}, {center_c})")
        result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c}])
        print(f"  Result: {result.get('action_display', 'N/A')}")
        
        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        nodes = seg['nodes']
        green = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
        purple = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'p']
        white = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W']
        sky = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'S']
        print(f"  After: green={len(green)}, purple={purple[0]['pixels'] if purple else 0}, white={white[0]['pixels'] if white else 0}, blue={sky[0]['pixels']}")
        print(f"  Level completed: {result.get('level_completed', False)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
